config.reflectionMd: You ran XOR for twenty epochs and the line never settled. Write down, in your own words, *why* -- not "it is not linearly separable", but what you saw the line doing and which points it kept trading off. Lesson 2 has the algebra; your sentence is the thing you will actually remember.

tasks.label: Reach 100% accuracy on the blobs dataset
tasks.hintMd: Pick **blobs**, then hold down auto-run. The two clouds are linearly separable, so the rule goes quiet the moment it finds a line.

tasks.label: Run at least 20 epochs on XOR and watch it fail
tasks.hintMd: Switch to **xor** and run epochs. Watch the accuracy readout bounce instead of climbing -- the rule is cycling, not converging.
